EPSS stands for Enhanced Protection Profile Score, which is a metric used to evaluate the severity and likelihood of a vulnerability being exploited in the real world. Unlike CVSS, which focuses solely on the severity of the vulnerability, EPSS takes into account various factors such as the prevalence of the vulnerability, the effectiveness of available mitigations, and the likelihood of exploitation.
